dataset: Deck and season names, and who uses which
why: Every source names the same decks differently, and this site has twice published a wrong count of one deck’s names. This file is the running record so the next page does not have to guess. See DATA.md.

sources_key.players: player posts seen in keyword searches

names.name: ジョラゴンジョーカーズ
names.note: The survey’s own name until 27 September.
names.absent_from_daily: Not on any chart in data-nd-daily.json, whose record starts 24 September and carries ジョーカーズ from that day. If the survey used this name until the 27th, the 24-26 September rows should carry it. Those three days are partial six-column reads and the label has not been re-read, so NOTHING is changed here on the strength of the note alone.

names.name: ジョーカーズ

names.name: 自然ジョーカーズ
names.absent_from_daily: Not on any chart in data-nd-daily.json and it has no note saying when the survey used it. It may be a players' name recorded as the survey's. Left as written rather than reassigned, because reassigning it would be a guess about which source said it.
names.publisher_use: Settled on 29 October 2026 that the NAME is the publisher's, not a coinage: news/16477 and news/16479 both give 『自然ジョーカーズ』 as the title of the SP Rule Match collaboration deck built on 舞元啓介, and the rental-deck image of that event names the same five decks. That does NOT answer what this entry asks, which is whether the SURVEY ever used the label. used_by is unchanged for that reason.

decks.note: First appeared in the ND survey on 13 October 2026 at 2.6%. The key card has not been confirmed from a source this site can cite, so site_name is a transliteration of the survey label only. Confirm before using it in an article.

decks.page_headers_note: The 27 September page heads this deck by civilisation. Its six dated cells cannot be compared: 24-29 September are partial six-column reads and the record does not hold 赤単バルガ for them, so check.py reports them as not comparable rather than passing or failing. That is a gap in the record, not an error on the page.

seasons.name_official: HADES・ドラゲリオンカップ
seasons.note: Not on the news index. Named after a card that is also a deck name, which contaminates keyword searches on that name.

seasons.name_official: オラマッハ・ザ・ジョニーカップ
seasons.confirmed_by: news/16308, 「【ランクマッチ】オラマッハ・ザ・ジョニーカップ開催！」, which gives 開催期間 2026年10月16日（金）00:00 ～ 2026年11月15日（日）23:59. Located on 26 October by probing notice numbers: it is no longer on the news index front page, which shows only ten items.
seasons.note: Covers every reading from 16 October on, so the whole window of the 22 October card change sits inside one season. Days on or before 15 October are on the previous ladder (HADES・ドラゲリオンカップ) and are not comparable to it on that count alone.

page_headers_why: site_name is the heading this site usually gives a deck's column, and check.py maps a table header to this deck's survey labels through it. page_headers lists the other headings pages have actually used, so those columns are checked instead of silently skipped. A column headed for a deck the survey splits across two labels is compared against the SUM of the labels present that day, which is what those pages print; known_convention_differences records the one page that deliberately prints a single entry instead. A header that means one specific label of a multi-label deck goes in page_header_labels instead, because mapping it to the family would compare a single-civilisation column against a family total.
